candidates.name: Midyan Gas Plant–Duba Sales Gas Pipeline
candidates.from: Midyan Gas Plant (near Tabuk, NW Red Sea coast)
candidates.to: bulk plant near SEC Duba power station, al-Muwaylih (Duba)

evidence.note: Midyan plant (production started 2017) processes 75 MMscf/d; project includes construction of two 98 km pipelines to deliver sales gas and hydrocarbon liquids to the ~570 MW power station near Duba (Green Duba Initiative), replacing diesel firing.

Two ~84 km parallel pipelines carry processed condensates and gas from Midyan to a bulk plant near the Saudi Electricity Company power plant at al-Muwaylih near Duba; construction 86% complete Oct 2016, completion Dec 2016.
Aramco building Midyan gas plant in NW Saudi Arabia to supply gas to the Duba power station, its first gas project in the northwestern region.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Every Saudi gas-transmission row in the GEM roster sits in the Eastern Province (Ghawar/MGS/UBTG/Berri cluster) or on the East–West line to Yanbu; there is no northwestern/Red Sea entry at all. The Midyan–Duba sales-gas line is a standalone regional transmission link (gas plant → power station, ~84–98 km, operating since 2017) with no name, endpoint, or alias match to any listed PID. Note it is a two-line pair — only the sales-gas line is in scope; the parallel condensate/liquids line is not gas transmission.
